ai.seo_question: Who were the 'others' that Allah drowned in Surah Al-Shu'ara?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the finality of divine retribution for those who stubbornly rejected the truth after clear signs were presented, serving as a warning to the contemporary disbelievers of Mecca. It connects the fate of previous nations, such as Pharaoh's army, to the ultimate accountability of the disbelievers, emphasizing that rejection of the Prophet's message leads to spiritual and physical destruction.
